newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica takes BA Merchant Services public.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica takes BA Merchant Services public.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp. Thursday took its BA Merchant Services Inc. subsidiary public in a $217 million stock offering that attracted strong demand.
The stock, priced at $15.50, rose $2.125 to $17.625 on the New York Stock Exchange, where it was the second most heavily traded issue at mid-afternoon.
The initial public offering had been expected to be priced at a range of $14 to $16.
Of the 14 million shares issued, 11.2 million were offered in the United States and 2.8 million overseas.
Assuming underwriters exercise an option to issue additional shares to meet unexpected demand, BankAmerica said it expected to recognise an after-tax gain of about $145 million in the fourth quarter.
